title: With the release of The Odyssey, we look at Nashville's nods to ancient Greece
description: For the 1897 Tennessee Centennial Exposition, Nashville decided to build a Parthenon. It was a temporary structure meant to last six months. It instead lasted over 20 years. A new Parthenon was then built-to-last.

title: Ancient City and Erawan Museum Ticket from Bangkok
Cat Mummies Were a Big Thing in Ancient Egypt
description: Archaelogists uncover what appear to be cat mummies–a common practice around the Ptolemaic period. But an x-ray scan reveals a surprise: the mummies are just bandages. So what happened?

title: 📚 Kids Explore Archaeology at Summer Reading Week 5
Ancient gold ornaments unearthed at Don Yai Thong site in Phetchaburi
description: Archaeologists have discovered more ancient gold ornaments at Don Yai Thong archaeological site in Phetchaburi, inside the same skeleton where a Brahmi-inscribed seal ring was found.
